description_en: Queries the details of a stack group by its name in an Alibaba Cloud region
description_zh: 在一个阿里云地域下根据资源栈组名称查询资源栈组详情
kebab_example: aliyun ros get-stack-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --stack-group-name MyStackGroup --stack-group-id fd0ddef9-9540-4b42-a464-94f778350000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetStackGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the stack group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈组所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the stack group. The name must be unique within a region. The name can be up to 255 characters in length, and must start with a digit or a letter. It can contain digits, letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

You must specify only one of the StackGroupName and StackGroupId parameters
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈组名称。名称在单个地域内唯一。   
长度不超过255个字符，必须以数字或英文字母开头，可包含数字、英文字母、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。

您必须且仅能指定StackGroupName或StackGroupId其中一个参数
parameters.name: stack_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the stack group.

You must specify only one of the StackGroupName and StackGroupId parameters
parameters.help_zh:
资源栈组ID。

您必须且仅能指定StackGroupName或StackGroupId其中一个参数
parameters.name: stack_group_id

StackGroup.description_en: The details of the stack group

AdministrationRoleName.description_en: The name of the RAM administrator role that is assumed by ROS. This parameter is specified when you create a stack group in self-managed permission mode. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value AliyunROSStackGroupAdministrationRole is returned
AdministrationRoleName.description_zh: 创建自助管理权限模式的资源栈组时，指定的供ROS扮演的RAM管理员角色名称。若不指定，则默认返回AliyunROSStackGroupAdministrationRole

AutoDeployment.description_en:
The information about automatic deployment settings.

This parameter is returned only if PermissionModel is set to SERVICE_MANAGED
AutoDeployment.description_zh:
自动部署设置信息。
仅当PermissionModel为SERVICE_MANAGED时，才会返回此参数

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic deployment is enabled or disabled.

Valid values:

true: Automatic deployment is enabled. If you add a new member account to the folder, the stack group automatically deploys stack instances in the specified region of the new account. If you remove a member account from the folder, the stack group automatically deletes stack instances from the specified region of the account.

false: Automatic deployment is disabled. After automatic deployment is disabled, the stack instances remain unchanged when the member accounts in the folder change
Enabled.description_zh:
启用或者禁用自动部署。

取值：

true：启用自动部署。启用自动部署后，如果目标资源夹中新增了成员账号，资源栈组会自动将资源栈实例部署到目标资源夹中新增账户的指定地域下。如果从目标资源夹中删除账户，资源栈组将从此账户的指定地域中删除资源栈实例。

false：禁用自动部署。禁用自动部署后，目标资源夹中成员账号变动时资源栈实例不会发生变化

RetainStacksOnAccountRemoval.description_en:
Indicates whether to retain the stacks in the member account when the member account is removed from the folder.

Valid values:

true: retains the stacks.

false: deletes the stacks.

This parameter is returned only if Enabled is set to true
RetainStacksOnAccountRemoval.description_zh:
目标资源夹中删除成员账号时，是否保留成员账号中的资源栈。

取值：

true：保留资源栈。

false：删除资源栈。

仅当Enabled返回true时，才会返回此参数

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the stack group was created

Description.description_en: The description of the stack group

ExecutionRoleName.description_en: The name of the RAM execution role that is assumed by the administrator role AliyunROSStackGroupAdministrationRole. This parameter is specified when you create a stack group in self-managed permission mode. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value AliyunROSStackGroupExecutionRole is returned
ExecutionRoleName.description_zh: 创建自助管理权限模式的资源栈组时，需指定的供管理员角色（AliyunROSStackGroupAdministrationRole）扮演的RAM执行角色名称。若不指定，则默认返回AliyunROSStackGroupExecutionRole

Parameters.description_en: The list of the parameters of the stack group

PermissionModel.description_en:
The permission model.

Valid values:

SELF_MANAGED: self-managed permissions.

SERVICE_MANAGED: service-managed permissions.

For more information about the permission models of stack groups, refer to [Overview]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154578.html）
PermissionModel.description_zh:
授权模式。

取值：

SELF_MANAGED：自助管理权限模式。

SERVICE_MANAGED：服务管理权限模式。

关于资源栈组的授权模式，请参见[概览]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/154578.html）

RdFolderIds.description_en:
The IDs of the folders in the resource directory. Stack instances are deployed in all the accounts in the folders.

This parameter is returned only if PermissionModel is set to SERVICE_MANAGED
RdFolderIds.description_zh:
资源目录中的目标资源夹ID列表。用于将资源栈实例部署在此资源夹中的所有账号中。

仅当PermissionModel为SERVICE_MANAGED时，才会返回此参数

items.description_en:
The IDs of the folders in the resource directory. Stack instances are deployed in all the accounts in the folders.

This parameter is returned only if PermissionModel is set to SERVICE_MANAGED
items.description_zh:
资源目录中的目标资源夹ID列表。用于将资源栈实例部署在此资源夹中的所有账号中。

仅当PermissionModel为SERVICE_MANAGED时，才会返回此参数

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group. This value is determined by the resource group ID that you specify when you create the stack group
ResourceGroupId.description_zh: 资源组ID。取决于创建资源栈组时，指定的资源组ID

StackGroupDriftDetectionDetail.description_en: The details of the last successful drift detection operation on the stack group
StackGroupDriftDetectionDetail.description_zh: 资源栈组最近一次成功完成偏差检测的详情

CancelledStackInstancesCount.description_en: The number of stack instances for which the drift detection operation was canceled
CancelledStackInstancesCount.description_zh: 取消偏差检测的资源栈实例的数量

DriftDetectionStatus.description_en:
The drift detection status of the stack group.

Valid values:

COMPLETED: The drift detection operation is completed for the stack group. All stack instances have been successfully drift-detected.

FAILED: The drift detection operation is completed for the stack group. The number of stack instances that failed the drift detection exceeds the specified threshold.

PARTIAL_SUCCESS: The drift detection operation is completed for the stack group. The drift detection operation failed for some stack instances, but the number of failures did not exceed the threshold.

IN_PROGRESS: The drift detection operation is in progress for the stack group.

STOPPED: The drift detection operation on the stack group was canceled
DriftDetectionStatus.description_zh:
资源栈组偏差检测状态。

取值：
COMPLETED：资源栈组偏差检测结束，所有资源栈实例均成功完成了偏差检测。
FAILED：资源栈组偏差检测结束，失败的资源栈实例偏差检测数量超过了设定的阈值。
PARTIAL_SUCCESS：资源栈组偏差检测结束，部分资源栈实例偏差检测失败，但失败数量没有超过阈值。
IN_PROGRESS：资源栈组偏差检测进行中。
STOPPED：用户取消了资源栈组的偏差检测

DriftDetectionTime.description_en: The time when the drift detection operation was performed on the stack group
DriftDetectionTime.description_zh: 资源栈组偏差检测时间

DriftedStackInstancesCount.description_en: The number of stack instances that are in the DRIFTED state
DriftedStackInstancesCount.description_zh: 处于偏差状态的资源栈实例的数量

FailedStackInstancesCount.description_en: The number of stack instances for which the drift detection operation failed
FailedStackInstancesCount.description_zh: 偏差检测失败的资源栈实例的数量

InProgressStackInstancesCount.description_en: The number of stack instances on which a drift detection operation is in progress
InProgressStackInstancesCount.description_zh: 偏差检测中的资源栈实例的数量

InSyncStackInstancesCount.description_en: The number of stack instances that are in the IN_SYNC state
InSyncStackInstancesCount.description_zh: 处于同步状态的资源栈实例的数量

StackGroupDriftStatus.description_en:
The drift status of the stack group.

Valid values:

DRIFTED: At least one stack instance has drifted.

NOT_CHECKED: No successful drift detection has been performed on the stack group.

IN_SYNC: All stack instances are in the IN_SYNC state
StackGroupDriftStatus.description_zh:
资源栈组偏差状态。

取值：
DRIFTED：至少一个资源栈实例处于偏差状态。
NOT_CHECKED：资源栈组未进行过成功的偏差检测。
IN_SYNC：所有资源栈实例均处于同步状态

StackGroupId.description_en: The ID of the stack group

StackGroupName.description_en: The name of the stack group

Status.description_en:
The status of the stack group.

Valid values:

ACTIVE: The stack group is active.

DELETED: The stack group is deleted
Status.description_zh:
资源栈组状态。

取值：

ACTIVE：激活。
DELETED：已删除

TemplateBody.description_en:
The structure of the template body.

We recommend that you do not use this parameter. Use TemplateContent instead
TemplateBody.description_zh:
模板主体的结构。

不建议使用该返回参数，建议使用TemplateContent代替

TemplateContent.description_en: The structure of the template body. The structure is in the JSON format. For more information, refer to [Template syntax]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28857.html）
TemplateContent.description_zh:
模板主体的结构，JSON格式。
更多信息，请参见[模板语法]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28857.html）

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the stack group was updated
